test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 2 (Held On: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.**

We do not sell stationery at this shop.

options.text: Stationery is not being sold at this shop.
Stationery has not been sold at this shop.
Stationery is not sold at this shop.
Stationery will not sell at this shop.

solution:
The passive voice of the given sentence is __**Stationery is not sold at this shop.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**__Simple present tense __

 
• We use the **simple present** tense when an action is happening right now, or when it happens regularly
